name: Plastic chair
short_description:
Stackable PP plastic chair, indoor & outdoor, easy clean, for canteen, school, F&B and community centre
Heavy duty injection moulded plastic stacking chair, waterproof for commercial public areas
description:
Chair Shell: Made of brand-new polypropylene (PP) reinforced with glass fiber and manufactured using a one-piece molding process. The shell surface features a square grid pattern consisting of 25 horizontal and 21 vertical cells, with a thickness of 7mm, ensuring structural stability. The surface texture is neatly arranged and tightly interlocked like fish scales, shimmering with a subtle glow to create a unique visual effect. The hollowed-out area in the center of the backrest is like the blank space left by the agile posture of a fish, complementing the "fish scale" texture. The seat and overall shape are clean and smooth, combining aesthetics with practicality. Complies with GB 32487-2016 General Technical Requirements for Plastic Furniture.
Chair Shell Dimensions: Back height: 350mm; Back width: 440mm; Seat depth: 470mm; Seat width: 460mm. The hollowed-out section of the chair shell measures 350mm in length and 80mm in width. The chair shell thickness is 7mm, ensuring structural stability.
Frame: Constructed from high-quality steel with a diameter of 19mm and a wall thickness of 1.5mm. It features a cantilever (bow-shaped) structure and is treated with pickling and electroplating or electrostatic powder coating. The overall stability is exceptionally high. Material inspection must comply with GB/T 3325-2017, QB/T 3832-1999, and QB/T 3827-1999, and pass a continuous 24-hour acetic acid salt spray test.
Testing Standards: Tested according to general office chair standards. It can bear a load of 180kg. The backrest undergoes a one-time tensile test of 108kg with a 1-minute pressure hold. The PP backrest passes a 120,000-cycle push-back test at 40kg. The surface is waterproof, free of any watermarks and burrs, and designed to meet ergonomic requirements. (Optional upholstered seat cushion available for the seat).
Overall Chair Dimensions: Seat height: 470mm; Seat depth: 470mm; Seat width: 460mm; Total height: 840mm.
Standard Colors: Available in 7 colors (Black, White, Grey, Red, Green, Yellow, Purple).

Made of high-grade PP plastic, sturdy & impact-resistant
Lightweight, easy to move & rearrange
 UV & weather resistant, suitable for indoor & outdoor use
 Smooth non-porous surface, waterproof, stain-resistant, simple wipe-clean
Multiple color options, widely used for events, restaurant, hotel, school, home

name: ESD Sticky mat
description:
Product Characteristics
Each layer is coated with a unique high-tack or low-tack adhesive.
Product dimensions are suitable for various locations.
Numbered tabs make it easy to separate one sheet from the next.
The multi-layered, straight-edged sticky floor mat can quickly and effectively remove dust from transport vehicle wheels and shoe soles, keeping the environment clean and simple to use. If the surface layer becomes contaminated, simply peel it off. It is lightweight, easy to carry, and can quickly and effectively eliminate static electricity in a general area.
This is an optimal tool for use in static-sensitive, high-hazard areas such as electronics processing, pre-press processing, and plastics processing.
Non-toxic and Environmentally Friendly: Passed the latest EU ROHS 2.0 environmental directive. It does not contain lead-based heavy metals, plasticizers, or other harmful substances. Bacterial and microbial levels are within standards and have passed national testing for sanitary products.
Odorless: The antibacterial, cleanroom-grade products have passed antibacterial testing in accordance with American ASTM and international ISO standards.
High Antibacterial Properties: Antibacterial, cleanroom-grade products can achieve an antibacterial rate of over 90%. Mildew-resistance determination meets Level 1 standards.
High Dust Removal Rate: Provides a continuous, excellent dust-sticking effect with superior tackiness. Its adhesive strength is over 30% higher than similar products.
Low Consumption Rate: Because the viscosity is guaranteed and stable, customer usage statistics show that under the same conditions, the material consumption per unit of time is more than 1/5 lower than other manufacturers.
No Adhesive Residue: In environments with large temperature variations, the viscosity remains stable and does not leave adhesive residue. It effectively removes dust from shoe soles and wheels, minimizing the impact of dust on the clean environment and quickly achieving a simple dust removal effect. It solves the problem of other mats having incomplete dust removal, which cannot guarantee the prevention of dust spread.
Excellent Tear Resistance: The film is made from 100% new materials using an advanced blow-molding process, completely avoiding recycled materials. Under normal use, the film is not easily torn. Its longitudinal and transverse tensile strength is more than 2 times the national standard.
Beautiful Appearance: Factory products are wrinkle-free, flat, and glossy. Dimensions are standard, with no cutting corners or shoddy work. The numbered tabs are prominent, flush, and easy to use.
Export-Grade Packaging: Features three-layer (or more) export-grade cardboard protective packaging. This includes: an inner-sealed plastic bag + reinforced cardboard lining + a hardboard outer carton + (for single-box shipments, an additional outer layer of thick, shock-proof bubble wrap is added).
Reliable Guarantee: Annually undergoes and passes inspection by authoritative third-party testing organizations. Annually passes authoritative testing for EU environmental standards and corresponding national standards for sanitary products. Annually passes the ISO9001 quality system supervision audit by an internationally renowned classification society. The quality of every product batch is fully traceable

name: ESD Anti-Fatigue Mat
description:
Premium ESD Anti-Fatigue Mat
This high-performance mat is an essential dual-purpose solution for any workspace requiring both electrostatic protection and ergonomic support, such as electronics assembly lines, laboratories, and repair centers. It is engineered with an advanced three-layer composite structure to deliver superior comfort and reliable ESD performance.
Intelligent Three-Layer Construction:
Anti-Static Top Layer: A durable, anti-slip surface made of static-dissipative rubber or PVC. It safely drains static charges and is resistant to common acids and alkalis.
Ergonomic Foam Core: A high-resilience foam cushion layer that effectively reduces foot and leg pressure, providing significant anti-fatigue relief for standing workers.
Conductive Bottom Layer: A fully conductive rubber base that provides a reliable and rapid path-to-ground for static electricity, ensuring the entire mat remains a safe, grounded surface.
Key Features:
Certified ESD Protection: Meets stringent standards for surface and volume resistance, ensuring sensitive electronic components are protected.
Superior Ergonomic Comfort: The cushioned core significantly reduces fatigue and discomfort associated with prolonged standing.
Environmentally Safe: Manufactured using an eco-friendly process, this mat is completely formaldehyde-free and compliant with EU RoHS standards.
Durable and Safe: Features an anti-slip surface and chemical resistance for a safer working environment.
Convenient & Stable: Lightweight and easy to move for cleaning without disrupting workflow, yet stable enough to stay firmly in place during use.

name: ESD Antistatic Rubber Mat CXB15
description:
The CXB15 is a premium, double-layer anti-static mat engineered for superior electrostatic discharge protection in sensitive work environments. Unlike common mats made from recycled materials, the CXB15 is crafted from high-quality virgin rubber, imported nitrile rubber, and superconducting carbon black. This results in greater stability, enhanced durability, and consistent, long-term ESD performance with a very low odor.
Advanced Double-Layer Protection:
The mat’s intelligent two-layer design ensures a safe and controlled path for static electricity to ground.
Static Dissipative Top Layer: This surface layer is designed to slowly and safely drain static charges from components, tools, and personnel, preventing damage from rapid discharge events. Its surface resistivity is in the ideal dissipative range of 1.0 × 10^6 to 1.0 × 10^9 ohms.
Static Conductive Bottom Layer: This black layer provides a rapid and reliable path for the collected static charge to move to a grounding point, ensuring the entire work surface remains free of hazardous static buildup. Its resistivity is in the highly conductive range of 1.0 × 10^3 to 1.0 × 10^5 ohms.
Key Features:
High-Quality Virgin Rubber: Offers superior stability and a longer lifespan compared to recycled rubber mats.
Environmentally Safe: Fully compliant with the latest EU RoHS 2.0 standards for hazardous materials.
Durable & Resilient: With a high tensile strength of over 6.6 MPa and a Shore A hardness of 75, this mat is built to withstand the rigors of a professional workshop.
Versatile Options: Available in multiple thicknesses (2mm to 5mm), widths, colors, and a choice of matte or bright surface finishes to suit any workspace.
Guaranteed Performance: Backed by a 2-year warranty for its anti-static properties.

name: Signage Customization | Custom Safety Warning & Directional Signs for Singapore Commercial Spaces
description:
Signage customization is the process of designing, producing, and tailoring signs, displays, or visual markers to meet specific requirements, purposes, brand identities, environments, or functional needs.
It transforms standard or generic sign templates into unique, targeted visual solutions that effectively communicate information, reinforce branding, guide navigation, or convey messages in a clear and impactful way.
Core Aspects of Customization
Design Tailoring: Covers visual elements including shape, size, colour scheme, typography, graphics, logos, icons, and layout. Designs can align with brand guidelines, match the style of a space (modern, classic, industrial, etc.), or comply with specific regulatory or aesthetic standards.
Material Selection: Choices range from durable options such as metal, acrylic, wood, PVC, and glass, to flexible or temporary materials like vinyl, fabric, or paper. The selection is based on the intended location (indoor or outdoor), durability requirements, budget, and preferred finish (matte, glossy, textured, etc.).
Functional Adaptation: Customised for specific uses — such as directional signs, information boards, safety notices, promotional displays, or decorative markers. Optional features can include illumination (backlit or LED), weather resistance, anti-glare coatings, or interactive elements.
Size & Format Flexibility: Ranges from small desk signs, nameplates, and door plaques, to large building signage, billboards, wayfinding systems, or floor decals. All dimensions and formats are customised to suit the installation space and intended viewing distance.
Content Personalization: Includes custom text, slogans, brand messaging, symbols, maps, or data, ensuring each sign delivers exactly the intended message to your target audience.
For more information, please share your design requirements, and we will provide you with a detailed price quotation.

name: Ergonomic Office Chair A926
description:
This is a high-specification ergonomic mesh office chair designed for premium comfort and adjustability. It features a fully adjustable 4D headrest and an adaptive lumbar support system integrated into its one-piece nylon-fiberglass backrest. The chair is upholstered in a high-performance, breathable TPEE-polyester mesh, prized for its durability and vibrant, non-fading color.
Key functional highlights include 3D adjustable armrests, a full-mesh seat with a comfortable foam waterfall edge, and a high-end, weight-sensitive recline mechanism with a 3-position lock. The entire chair is supported by an SGS-certified Class-3 gas lift and a BIFMA-tested 350mm aluminum alloy base, complete with smooth, 60mm hollow PU “silent” casters.
Headrest: 4D Nylon Headrest, adjustable up/down, forward/backward, rotation, and tilt.
Backrest: One-piece molded nylon and fiberglass frame, with an adaptive lumbar support (equipped with a 3.6mm heat-treated, hardened spring).
Fabric (Mesh): A blend of 68% Polyester and 32% TPEE (high-elastic fiber).
Features: Vibrant, non-fading colors, high tensile strength, wear-resistant, non-toxic, rot-resistant, chemical-resistant, high-temperature and UV resistant, highly breathable, and has a long service life.
Configuration: Brand-new nylon-fiberglass backrest, 4D headrest.
Armrests: 3D Armrests with a PU (polyurethane) surface, adjustable forward/backward, left/right, and up/down to provide reasonable support and relax the arms.
Seat: Full mesh “hollow” seat cushion with a foam “waterfall” edge at the front, making it more breathable and comfortable.
Gas Lift: SGS-certified, electroplated, Class-3 gas lift.
Mechanism (Chassis): Wire-controlled, weight-sensitive recline mechanism with a 3-position tilt lock. Features ergonomic support and a high degree of comfort.
Base & Casters: 350mm aluminum alloy 5-star base (BIFMA tested). Equipped with 60mm hollow PU silent casters for smooth, flexible, and noiseless omnidirectional movement.
Packing Dimensions: 78 * 36 * 64 (cm)
Packing: 1 chair per box.
short_description: This is a high-specification ergonomic mesh office chair designed for premium comfort and adjustability. It features a fully adjustable 4D headrest and an adaptive lumbar support system integrated into its one-piece nylon-fiberglass backrest. The chair is upholstered in a high-performance, breathable TPEE-polyester mesh, prized for its durability and vibrant, non-fading color.

name: Modular Steel Bookshelf System
description:
📚 Modular Steel Bookshelf System
Build a library or organize your office with our versatile and expandable steel bookshelf system. This system is designed to grow with your needs, allowing you to create a single standalone shelf or a continuous row of any length.
How This System Works:
Main Rack (Starter Unit): To start any new row, you must purchase one Main Rack. This is a complete, standalone unit that includes two end uprights.
Add-on Rack (Extension Unit): To extend your row, you purchase Add-on Racks. These units are more cost-effective as they share an upright with the unit beside them (they only come with one end upright).
Key Features:
Fully Modular: Start with a Main Rack and attach as many Add-on Racks as you need.
Two Height Options: Choose from 5-Layer or 6-Layer models to fit your space.
Sided Configuration:
Single-Sided: Perfect for placing against a wall.
Double-Sided: Ideal for creating aisles in the middle of a room, with access from both sides.
